title.zh: Gradium开源超小语音模型：权重仅64MB，手机断网也能开口说话
title.en: Gradium开源超小语音模型：权重仅64MB，手机断网也能开口说话

current_state.zh: AI speech company Gradium open-sourced Phonon, a distilled 31M/40M-parameter text-to-speech model whose 64MB Q8 English weights run on ordinary CPUs (7.5ms first audio, 24x realtime) and which beats larger open TTS models on blind-listening Elo and word error rate, with the English version under Apache 2.0.
